item.title: [Mon, Jun 8] Birding with Katie
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Patagonia Telluride, TELLURIDE Join local birder Katie Triest for an intro discussion about the birds of Telluride at the Telluride Patagonia store on June 8th from 5-6 and for a bird walk with Katie leaving from the Telluride Patagonia store on June 9th at 8:30 am. Folks can sign up for the bird walk on Patagonia's Instagram or come on into the Patagonia store. The talk and walk are free and open to all ages.
